title: Chapter 899
text:
A few days later …

In the Army Commander's Machinery Factory, Han Xiao had built a production line for the totem device and the Ovitan Badge according to the information. It was fully automated, and new products were produced every second, automatically delivered to the warehouse that Han Xiao had specially allocated. As for the Genetic Collapse Missile, he had not put it into mass production for the time being and had only built a test product.

Han Xiao took out three samples to test.

The totem device was a black cylinder that was five meters tall and two meters in diameter. It had a large base, and the surface of the cylinder was engraved with silver energy circuits. It was not charged at this time and was in an inactive state.

The Ovitan Badge was half the size of a palm and did not look very eye-catching.

Han Xiao used his finger to draw the pattern of the passkey on the base of the totem device. The totem device let out a hiss, and the surface of the base rotated more than half a circle, revealing a black groove. This was the interface of the energy circuit, which was used to fill the fuel.

Han Xiao took out the portable storage device of the Evolution Cube, activated it, and directed a black snake-like evolution energy into the groove at the base of the totem device.

The next moment, the totem device suddenly vibrated.

Hum!

As soon as the fuel was filled, the totem device was activated. The silver energy circuits on the surface of the cylinder lit up from bottom to top and started to flicker slowly. The frequency was like breathing. This evolution energy underwent a series of transformations within the totem device and was constantly diluted. It turned from highly concentrated energy into invisible radiation, which was then released by the totem device at a constant output.

"The totem device needs to be charged before it can be used. This evolutionary energy can allow it to operate for more than ten days. The more fuel you put in, the longer it can last. The upper limit of a totem device's fuel storage is 20 years of operation. The Evolutionary Civilization charges it once every 20 years."

Han Xiao carefully observed the operation of the totem device. In his senses, the totem device had become a source of radiation, constantly emitting diluted evolution energy radiation. Its range of influence was rapidly expanding, and it was only a matter of time before it covered the entire Black Star Corps Headquarters.

[Continuous Gene Optimization]: You are shrouded in evolution radiation. Your potential aptitude will slowly increase, and more potential aptitude will be increased when your species sublimates.

Han Xiao nodded. Directly using the Evolution Cube would also increase one's Potential Aptitude. Potential Aptitude was a hidden attribute that was directly related to one's attributes. Every time the attributes brought about by the Species Evolution were replenished, the principle was that the Potential Aptitude had changed.

The totem device was different from the one-time enhancement of the Evolution Cube. The effect of the totem device was slower, and the advantage was that the enhancement effect was not dependent on one's Energy Level. It was more suitable for everyone to use and did not have the side effect of an experience penalty.

As long as he was within the range of the totem, the buff would not disappear.

Han Xiao reached out and touched the totem device that was in operation. There was a corresponding item introduction on the panel.

[Evolutionary Totem (Activated)]: Special product of the Evolutionary Civilization. Using the energy of the Evolution Cube as fuel, it optimizes the genetic structure of creatures on a large scale and increases the potential of creatures. It also increases the chances of non-supers awakening.

"This thing can be used on a large scale, but we have to report it to the dynasty first." Han Xiao nodded.

As EsGod's legacy was divided among many organizations, the information of the Evolutionary Civilization would definitely spread. Although it would not be made public in the universe, the advanced civilizations would definitely have ways to obtain this information, so it was impossible to hide it.

As an ally of the dynasty, he definitely had to provide such a good thing to the Red Empire on a large scale in exchange for more support and attention.

Once the technology of the Evolutionary Totem spread, the attractiveness of the Evolution Cube to civilizations would increase by a few levels. Only by feeding the dynasty would the dynasty continue to help him block the greed of countless organizations.

As for selling the Evolutionary Totem to other civilizations, he would need to discuss with the dynasty. Both sides were allies, and he could not make the decision alone. If he sold it on a large scale, it would incur the dynasty's displeasure. After all, the dynasty did not want to see their enemy enjoy the benefits of the Evolutionary Totem.

As he thought about it, Han Xiao casually picked up the Ovitan Badge and injected some evolution energy into it.

Note: "Countless failed extreme evolution experiments have wasted a lot of funds, and the upper echelons have accused us of not being able to produce results. Therefore, based on the experience of failure, we created this … er, lame by-product. Originally, we just wanted to scam them for investment, but the upper echelons seemed to be very satisfied. The next year, they increased the funding for the extreme evolution project by 40%."

Han Xiao played with it for a while, then put it back on the table.

The side effects of this thing were too great, and he was not interested in trying it out personally.

The Ovitan Badge was not much of a threat to a Beyond Grade A, and a Beyond Grade A had great control over their energy. Even if the evolution energy entered their body, it would take them some time to expel it out of their body. This biochemical toxin could not even kill a Calamity Grade, let alone a Beyond Grade A.

Compared to the Evolutionary Totem, the value of the Ovitan Badge was far inferior. However, it was still very useful.

"Just nice, I can turn the image of the Ovitan Badge into the insignia of the Black Star Corps and make it a faction specialty. The badges of other organizations only have ornamental effects, but my badge can provide an explosive effect. This is quite cool."

Han Xiao stroked his chin and pondered. "Let's find a few players to test this thing first before selling it."

As for the Genetic Collapse Missile, Han Xiao did not charge it and only looked at the item description.

[Genetic Collapse Missile]: A special biochemical weapon of the Evolutionary Civilization. It can cause the genes of living creatures to collapse and is often used to slaughter planets.

"This weapon is suitable for eliminating the resistance on the surface of a planet. However, it is useless in a galactic war. In comparison, I prefer a small portable Genetic Collapse Bomb." — Mo Sen, Evolution Cube Genetic Technology Institute, Head of Weapon Development

Han Xiao took out his communicator and sent the test report of the Evolutionary Totem to Uranril's private number. Not long after, the communicator rang.

Picking up the call, Uranril's remote projection appeared in front of Han Xiao.

"Black Star, you've created the Evolutionary Totem?"

"Yes, I've tested it, and it can be used. I contacted you to discuss this matter."

"Very good!"

Uranril was pleasantly surprised, but she did not show it on her face.

She paused for a moment and realized a problem. Her tone sank.

"The information of the Evolvers came from EsGod's legacy, and the technology to create the Evolutionary Totem has already been leaked. More organizations will have this technology."

"Yes, but there is only one Evolution Cube as the energy source."

Han Xiao nodded. "I will provide the Evolutionary Totem to the dynasty on a large scale. On the other hand, I will also sell the Evolutionary Totem to other civilizations. Of course, the prerequisite is that it does not harm the interests of the dynasty. I will only sell it to civilizations that are close to the dynasty."

Uranril's eyes sparkled.

"Okay, I understand what you mean."

The Evolutionary Totem was extremely attractive to civilizations, and the dynasty had the strength to monopolize it. However, doing so would cause more civilizations to be unhappy and coveted, which was not a good thing. This pressure would be transferred to Han Xiao to a large extent.

Han Xiao's intention was to use the Evolutionary Totem as a bargaining chip, and the civilizations that wanted to purchase it would have to be close to or ally with the dynasty. This way, the dynasty would be able to rope in more political allies, and he would be able to gain a large amount of connections and money.

The dynasty would eat the meat, and the allied civilizations would have the soup. If the other civilizations saw the way to obtain the Evolutionary Totem, the pressure on him would be greatly reduced.

Furthermore, this was not a one-time deal. The Evolutionary Totem required fuel to operate, or it would not be usable. Thus, the civilizations that purchased it would have to maintain a long-term relationship with Han Xiao. They would have to renew the contract with him time and time again to recharge the Evolutionary Totem. The profits would be endless, and the value of the Evolutionary Totem would be reduced to a certain extent. Even if some civilizations bought it from the black market, they would not be able to use it forever.

Uranril considered for a while and agreed to this plan.

After all, the Totem was not a military weapon but something that would benefit the people. The advanced civilizations would all research genetic technology, but they were not as advanced as the Evolutionary Civilization. Thus, the Totem was not as sensitive. Monopolizing it would be good, but it would be attacked politically. If it was a situation where one party dominated, the dynasty could ignore the opinions of the other civilizations. However, there were still Radiance and Ethereal on the same level, and she had to consider this point. Han Xiao's plan was a win-win situation to a certain extent.

The two of them discussed for a while and reached a consensus. The rest of the details of the cooperation would be left to their subordinates.

After ending the call, Han Xiao thought for a moment before opening the faction interface and issuing a mission.

[Product Tester]

Mission Introduction: Black Star has recently developed a new product and requires volunteers to test it at the headquarters (there is a risk of death).

Mission Requirements: Help Black Star test the product.

Reward: 100,000 Experience, 500 Black Star Corps Contribution Points, 50,000 Enas

Remarks: Only 10 people are allowed to complete this mission. The test will begin in 3 hours. If you fail to complete this mission, -1000 Contribution Points and -20 Black Star Favorability Points.

There were only ten missions, and as soon as they were released, they were all accepted by people.

…

Three hours later, the ten players arrived at the testing ground indicated by Philip and looked around.

One of them was Pork Bun.

The fall of EsGod made him smell the scent of news, so he rushed back to wait for Han Xiao. He had been staying in the headquarters recently and was just in time for the mission.

"Pork Bun, you're in the headquarters too?"

"You dog, hurry up and update!"

"Are you afraid of a blade in front of you?"

The other nine players also greeted Bun-Hit-Dog in a physical way.

The Black Star Series had been updated so many times, and it had already attracted a large number of fans. Bun-Hit-Dog was more or less a celebrity among the players. No matter where he was, he would always meet a large group of people who wanted him to update the series.

After messing around for a while, the door opened again, and Han Xiao walked in with his hands behind his back.

"Hello, Army Commander ~" Bun-Hit-Dog hurriedly broke free from the burly men all over him and greeted him in a very obsequious manner. He had a smile on his face that deserved a beating.

"Oh, it's you. Long time no see."

Han Xiao patted his shoulder.

Pork Bun immediately felt energized and a sense of accomplishment.

Han Xiao turned around to look at everyone, coughed, and slowly said, "Since everyone is here, let's begin. The product we're going to test this time might have a huge side effect."

As he said that, Han Xiao took out ten fully charged Ovitan Badges and changed the pattern to the Black Star Corps emblem.

The ten players received one badge and browsed through the item introduction.

Seeing the introduction, Pork Bun's eyes lit up, and he immediately turned on the recording function.

Now, even the players knew that the Evolution Cube was in the hands of their Army Commander, but Black Star did not let the players use it on a large scale. Pork Bun felt that the appearance of the Ovitan Badges might be a sign that the Evolution Cube was going to be popularized.

"Let's begin when you're ready." Han Xiao nodded.

Everyone looked at each other and put on the Ovitan Badges without hesitation.

Although the side effect of the item was certain death, the mission reward was 50,000 Enas. Even to the current players, it was not a small sum. It was still quite profitable.

The first player to use the Ovitan Badge immediately experienced an earth-shattering change in his body.

His flesh and blood multiplied, and bone spikes protruded from his body. His body swelled up like a balloon, and he quickly turned into a five-meter-tall mutated creature. He looked like a monster with tumors all over his body, and the skin on his face was torn apart by his bulging muscles. He looked extremely terrifying.

The other nine people were stunned and subconsciously stopped their actions of activating the badges.

However, before they could say anything, the player who had turned into a mutated creature screamed.

"What the f * ck! What the hell did I turn into? "

…
